recognition.scope_statement: Directive 93/42/EEC gives designated notified bodies bounded conformity-assessment and certificate suspension/withdrawal functions.

legal_relevance.statement: Within the recognized conformity-assessment role, a notified body may suspend a certificate where Directive requirements are no longer met unless corrective measures restore compliance.

guardrails: The private determination is attributed through the manufacturer field safety notice hosted by a regulator; the underlying NB decision document is not treated as directly observed.
The later competent-authority corrective-action request and manufacturer recall remain separate events.
Notified-body status does not make SZUTEST a Member State competent authority.
